description_long: U F C W Local 1776 is a federal credit union serving members in , , established in 1963. As a not-for-profit financial cooperative, credit unions typically offer lower loan rates, higher savings rates, and fewer fees than traditional banks. This credit union carries a low-income designation, meaning it serves predominantly low-income members and may offer special programs like Payday Alternative Loans (PALs) — small, affordable loans designed to replace predatory payday lending. The credit union operates 2 branch locations. Deposits are federally insured up to $250,000 by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).
